entities.name: Equilor
entities.description: One of the most ancient and distant planes, inhabited by long-lived humanlike beings; known mainly from Urza's visit.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who visited Equilor seeking the origin of the Phyrexians and left to prepare Dominaria for invasion.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: Urza's companion on the visit to Equilor.

entities.name: Equilorans
entities.description: Long-lived humanlike inhabitants of Equilor, who hold great knowledge; elders live in mountain caves.

entities.name: Shard of Twelve Worlds
entities.description: Barrier that prevented Phyrexians reaching Dominaria; destroyed while Urza was away.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Dark force Urza sought the origin of.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane Urza left unprotected and returned to prepare for invasion.

entities.name: Bloodhill Bastion
entities.description: City on a hill seemingly made of living tissue, guarded by sphinx-like creatures.

events.summary: Urza and Xantcha travel to Equilor seeking the origin of the Phyrexians, taking over a thousand years to find it.
events.quote: It took them far more than a thousand years to find the plane.

events.summary: The elders tell Urza the Phyrexians could not reach Dominaria because of the Shard of the Twelve Worlds.
events.quote: told him that the Phyrexians couldn't reach Dominaria because of the Shard of the Twelve Worlds

events.summary: Urza plans to turn Equilor into a mechanical paradise, which most elders reject.
events.quote: his intrusive plans weren't received well by the majority of the elders

events.summary: Told the Shard was destroyed, Urza planeswalks away from Equilor, never to return, to prepare Dominaria for invasion.
events.quote: Urza planeswalked away to prepare Dominaria for certain invasion

relations.quote: Urza and Xantcha traveled there in hopes of discovering the origin of the Phyrexians

relations.note: older than Dominaria, which has not always been the Nexus of the Multiverse
relations.quote: Dominaria has not always been the Nexus of the Multiverse
